components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Raised orange plastic key; the one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 15px/1.1 var(--font-text, 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif); color: #14161A; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF5A1F; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45), inset 0 -4px 6px -2px rgba(140,30,0,.42), 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(20,22,26,.6), 0 2px 4px rgba(20,22,26,.16); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 6px rgba(140,30,0,.45), 0 2px 4px rgba(20,22,26,.16); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #14161A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: ink ring, fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #14161A; font: 600 15px/1.1 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #14161A; transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .18s, color .18s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #14161A; color: #F6F7F9; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #14161A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Ink key used to submit the username slot.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #14161A; color: #F6F7F9; font: 600 15px/1.1 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16), inset 0 -4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 8px 14px -8px rgba(20,22,26,.7); transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .18s; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #23272E; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #14161A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Recessed Input Slot
components.description: Inset field; focus swaps the line ring for a 3px ink ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #FBFBFC; color: #14161A; font: 500 16px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(20,22,26,.2), 0 0 0 1px #C4C7D0; transition: box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #586070; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(20,22,26,.2), 0 0 0 3px #14161A; }

components.name: Label Sticker

components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 18px 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: #F6F7F9; color: #14161A; font: 600 1.05rem/1.1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transform: rotate(-4deg); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 0 0 1px rgba(20,22,26,.1), 0 14px 20px -12px rgba(20,22,26,.6); } .ds-sticker::before { content: ''; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF5A1F; }

narrative.overview:
The payment soundbox on every Vietnamese counter. The whole site is that object and its shop: a matte signal-orange plastic shell, a cool porcelain-grey ground, ink-black type and grille. The recurring material is the perforated dot lattice: a canvas grille that swells in waves, dot-matrix LED numerals, condensed printed label plates, raised plastic keys, recessed input slots, and a footer that reads as the regulatory label on the back of the device.

The system is calm between beats and precise during them. Surfaces are matte and physical (soft bevels, soft offset shadows), never glassy or luminous. One 5-second beat drives every animation, so the page behaves like one machine, not a collection of effects. The story it tells: money lands in your own account, the box only rings.
keyCharacteristics: Orange is the signal; cobalt is money; ink is structure and blocked states. Colour is a law, not a mood.
Hardware vocabulary: raised keys, recessed slots, label plates, LED panels, a barcode label.
Dot lattice is the one recurring texture (hero canvas, speaker grille, diagram paper, CTA, footer slot).
Editorial display type (wide-tight Bricolage) against printed-plate condensed labels and dot-matrix numerals.
Depth is soft and physical. No glow halos, no hard offset shadows.
One phase-locked beat; everything stops on pause or reduced motion.

rules.name: The Signal-Money-Ink Rule
rules.body: Orange means signal, alert, or the primary action. Cobalt means money or the creator's account. Ink means type, grille, or a held or blocked state. A colour never crosses its meaning.

rules.name: The Ink-Panel Rule
rules.body: LED colours (amber, blue) appear only on ink display panels with Doto numerals. They are never used on the grey ground, never as text colour elsewhere.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on orange is ink, never white.

rules.name: The Plate-Not-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Condensed uppercase labels are printed plates inside a component (lane title, footer heading, sticker on the shell). They never sit above a heading as an intro line.

rules.name: The LED Numeral Rule
rules.body: Only amounts and the 5-second promise are set in Doto, always on an ink panel.

rules.name: The Soft-Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a blur and a negative spread and is tinted from ink. A shadow with zero blur is forbidden, and a coloured glow around a light source is forbidden: light is drawn as fill (LED radial dot), never as halo.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Hover lifts a key 1-2px; active presses it 1px down and flips the bevel inward.

dos: Do keep orange for signal, alert and the primary action; cobalt for money and the creator's account; ink for type, grille and held or blocked states.
Do put LED amber and blue only on ink panels, set in Doto.
Do build depth from soft inner bevels plus soft, negative-spread, ink-tinted offset shadows.
Do set headings in Bricolage 800 at 92% width and -0.035em; labels in Barlow Condensed uppercase inside plates.
Do draw every icon in the sprite at 1.75 stroke, round caps.
Do drive any new motion off the 5s beat, with exponential ease-out, and honour the pause toggle and reduced motion.
Do use the dot lattice as the one recurring texture.
donts: Don't go dark neon gaming: no black-page with glowing accents, no glow halos or coloured blooms.
Don't use gradient text, glossy hardware-on-gradient hero staging, or hard offset (zero-blur) shadows.
Don't place a kicker, eyebrow or small label above a heading.
Don't lay out features as equal icon-card grids.
Don't use emoji, glyph characters or icon fonts as icons.
Don't put white text on orange, or use cobalt for anything that is not money or the account.
